title: Linear form on a prefixed sign vector
statement: For every natural number $n$, coefficient vector $a\in\mathbb{R}^{n+1}$, sign $b\in\{-1,1\}$, and vector $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$, the linear form satisfies $L_a(b,x)=a_0b+\sum_{i=1}^n a_i x_i$, where $(b,x)$ denotes the vector obtained by prefixing $b$ to $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a sign vector with $n$ coordinates
